'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[2021–2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
***The [[East African Community]] announces the extension of a mandate of a regional military force deployed to deal with the [[low-intensity conflict]] in the east of the country. Troops were first sent into the region after the resurgence of the [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebel group]].[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/6/east-africa-leaders-extend-regional-troop-mandate-in-dr-congo (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Twelve [[Pakistani Taliban]] gunmen and four [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] are killed in a [[shootout]] at a security outpost in the [[Kalasha Valleys]] in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/pakistan-clashes-near-afghan-border/7257257.html (VOA)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[September 2023 Kostiantynivka missile strike]]
****At least 15 people are killed and 30 others are injured in a [[missile]] strike on a marketplace in [[Kostiantynivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]] Kyiv blamed the attack on Russia, who denied involvement in the attack. An investigation by the New York Times found evidence which suggested a Ukrainian 9M38 missile fired by a mobile Buk antiaircraft vehicle was responsible for the strike. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/09/18/world/europe/ukraine-missile-kostiantynivka-market.html (New York Times)]
**[[Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United States]] announces a [[United States dollar|$]]175 million aid package for [[Ukraine]] that includes [[Depleted uranium#Ammunition|depleted uranium]] ammunition for the first time, intended for use with [[M1 Abrams|Abrams tanks]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ukraine-war-armor-piercing-rounds-u-s-weapons/ (CBS News)]
***[[Government of the United Kingdom|British]] [[Secretary of State for Defence|Defence Secretary]] [[Grant Shapps]] confirms reports by [[Russian officials]] that a [[Challenger 2]] [[tank]] was destroyed in Ukraine, marking the first loss of the model on the battlefield. [https://kyivindependent.com/uk-defense-secretary-confirms-challenger-2-tank-destroyed-in-ukraine/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**Russian pilot Maxim Kuzminov, who [[defection|defected]] to Ukraine with a [[MI-8 helicopter]], receives a $500,000 reward for defecting. [https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2023/9/6/russian-pilot-who-defected-to-ukraine-with-helicopter-gets-500000-reward (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Romania]]n [[Ministry of National Defence (Romania)|Ministry of National Defence]] confirms that debris from a Russian [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drone]] has been found on Romanian territory in [[Tulcea County]]. Romania denied claims that drones launched by Russia exploded on Romanian territory. [https://apnews.com/article/romania-danube-ukraine-drone-russia-49d7c2f087d19cd0363dc24b8b121f8d (AP)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings]]
***[[Sri Lanka's government]] announces that it will appoint a [[parliamentary committee]] to investigate allegations made in a [[Channel 4]] report that [[State Intelligence Service (Sri Lanka)|Sri Lankan intelligence]] was complicit in the bombings. [https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-sri-lanka-easter-blasts-b0595ea79ade9c131b0e703c93cdbbe5 (AP)]
*[[Tajikistan]] announces that it killed three [[Jamaat Ansarullah]] [[Islamist]] [[militant]]s on 29–30 August after the militants crossed [[Afghanistan–Tajikistan border|the border]] from [[Afghanistan]] to carry out [[terrorist]] attacks in Tajikistan. [https://www.barrons.com/news/tajikistan-kills-three-militants-from-afghanistan-f77112bd (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

''' Business and economy'''
*The [[National Bank of Poland]] announces significant interest cuts, lowering the reference rate from 6.75% to 6%, simultaneously causing the [[złoty]] to lose value against the [[American dollar|dollar]] and the [[euro]]. [https://www.seattletimes.com/business/polands-central-bank-cuts-key-interest-rate-despite-double-digit-inflation/ (''The Seattle Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**An [[extratropical cyclone]] in [[southern Brazil]] causes flooding in several cities, killing at least 27 people and leaving more than 1,600 people [[homeless]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-storm-floods-disaster-climate-97d946798a4ba1d3ef0269bfcdf3c70c (AP)]
*[[2023 Southeast Europe floods]]
**At least 10 people have been killed by floods caused by torrential rain in [[Bulgaria]], [[Turkey]], and [[Greece]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-europe-66728709 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Climate change in Africa]]
**The African Climate Summit in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]], ends with a call for world leaders to implement a global [[carbon footprint|carbon]] [[tax]] on [[fossil fuels]], transport and reforms of [[global financial system]]s which leaders say disproportionately disadvantages [[Africa]]n nations. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-climate-kenya-finance-65a5708b00e204a7c3d2783e81d3e1b6 (AP)]
*[[Russia–Turkey relations]]
**[[President of Russia]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and [[President of Turkey]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] hold talks in [[Sochi]], [[Russia]], to discuss the revival of the [[Black Sea Grain Initiative]], enabling the passage of grain across the [[Black Sea]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/04/middleeast/erdogan-putin-meeting-sochi-mime-intl/index.html (CNN)]

''' Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in Mexico]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Mexico|Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation]] decriminalizes [[abortion]] nationwide in [[Mexico]], ruling that laws prohibiting the procedure are unconstitutional and violate women’s rights. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-abortion-decriminalize-d87f6edbdf68c2e6c8f5700b3afd15de (AP)]
*[[Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations]]
**A [[U.S.]] federal court judge rules that [[Donald Trump]] is liable for damages in the second [[E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump|defamation case]] against journalist [[E. Jean Carroll]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/06/politics/e-jean-carroll-trump-defamation-lawsuit/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Human rights in France]]
**A schoolgirl in [[Lyon]], [[France]], is reportedly sent home for wearing a traditional [[Japan]]ese [[kimono]] as the nation implements a [[French law on secularity and conspicuous religious symbols in schools|controversial law]] banning the display of [[religious symbols]] in [[State school|public schools]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/6/french-school-expels-student-for-wearing-a-kimono-lawyer (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Prison escape of Daniel Khalife]]
**British former soldier Daniel Khalife, awaiting trial for terror and explosives offenses, escapes from [[HM Prison Wandsworth]] in southwest [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], triggering a nationwide manhunt. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-66733660 (BBC)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 in archosaur paleontology]]
**A [[dinosaur]] [[fossil]], given the name ''[[Fujianvenator]]'', is discovered in [[Fujian]], [[China]]. The dinosaur has two legs and two other limbs, possibly wings, thereby giving insight into the [[evolution]] of birds. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2489491-dinosaurus-ontdekt-die-nieuw-licht-werpt-op-evolutie-vogels (NOS)]
*[[Exploration of the Moon]]
**[[JAXA]] launches the [[Smart Lander for Investigating Moon]] (SLIM) [[lunar lander]] from [[Tanegashima Space Center]]. The [[Japan]]ese mission will aim to become the fifth country to perform a [[Soft landing (aeronautics)|soft landing]] on the [[Moon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/space/japan-launches-rocket-carrying-moon-lander-slim-after-three-delays-2023-09-06/ (Reuters)]
